1Matrices — eigenvalues of a 2×2 matrix

KEY FORMULA

λ² − (trace)λ + det = 0

What it meansThe eigenvalues of a 2×2 matrix are the two roots of this quadratic. You only need the trace (a + d) and the determinant (ad − bc).
Letters & unitsλ = eigenvalue; trace = sum of diagonal elements; det = |A|
When to useAny 'find the eigenvalues' question. For bigger matrices use: sum of eigenvalues = trace, product = determinant.
Worked exampleA = [4 1; 2 3]: trace 7, det 10 → λ² − 7λ + 10 = 0 → λ = 5, 2.
